data.boatName: M/B Prince Sibale / M/B St. Joseph
data.notes: Primary passenger boat. Coast Guard manifest registration required at Pinamalayan port terminal by 7:45 AM.
Departs early morning to connect with Mindoro land vans bound for Calapan or Roxas.
Direct connection from Calapan. Subject to sea condition advisories.
Chartered banca for group transfers across Tablas Strait.

data.name: Mount Tingarac Summit Ridge Trail
data.description: The premier summit climb of Maestro de Campo (Sibale Island). Climbs through dense tropical coconut canopy and endemic wild flora to reach the highest ridge on the island, featuring sweeping 360-degree vistas across Tablas Strait, Mindoro mountain ranges, and Marinduque.
data.terrainType: Forest soil, loose limestone pebbles, steep ridge switchbacks, exposed peak rock slab.
data.waterAvailability: Natural spring at 1.8km mark (boiling/filtering recommended). Carry min 1.5L.
data.safetyAdvisory: Start before 6:30 AM to avoid midday heat. Wear sturdy trail shoes with ankle support. Use caution near sheer eastern cliff edges at the summit marker.

waypoints.name: Poblacion Trailhead & Registry
waypoints.description: Sign in with the Barangay Eco-Tourism desk. Walking stick pickup and local guide meeting point.

waypoints.name: San Vicente Coconut Ridge
waypoints.description: First plateau offering views back down toward Concepcion Port and colorful anchored fishing bancas.

waypoints.name: Bawa Mountain Spring Rest Stop
waypoints.description: Cool natural mountain spring beneath wild banana palms. Shaded resting benches available.

waypoints.name: Old WWII Telegraph Post Ruins
waypoints.description: Historical concrete foundation used for coastal surveillance during the 1940s.

waypoints.name: Mount Tingarac 360° Summit Marker
waypoints.description: Highest geological point in Sibale. Panoramic marker plate and flag. Spectacular sea and island horizons.

data.name: Spanish Watchtower (Baluarte) Coastal Heritage Trail
data.description: A gentle cultural walking path connecting the town center plaza with 18th-century Spanish stone fortress ruins perched on coastal limestone bluffs. Beautiful sunset vantage points over turquoise reefs.
data.terrainType: Cobbled village paths, flat shaded dirt track, stone staircase at watchtower ascent.
data.waterAvailability: Multiple sari-sari stores along first kilometer in Poblacion.
data.safetyAdvisory: Comfortable family trail. Stone steps near the watchtower can be slick when wet after rain.

waypoints.name: St. Joseph Church & Town Plaza
waypoints.description: Start at the historic church courtyard with municipal heritage markers.

waypoints.name: Seaside Coconut Bluff Vista
waypoints.description: Scenic bench looking south towards Banton and Simara islands in the distance.

waypoints.name: 18th-Century Baluarte Stone Ruins
waypoints.description: Coral stone masonry watchtower built to spot pirate galleons in the 1700s.

waypoints.name: Bachawan White Sands Descent
waypoints.description: Trail ends directly at the soft white sands of Bachawan Beach for a refreshing swim.

data.name: Dampali Cliff & Secret Sea Cave Trek
data.description: An adventurous trek leading over dramatic jagged karst limestone bluffs down into hidden sea caves, natural tidal plunge pools, and private coral coves with crystal-clear turquoise waters.
data.terrainType: Sharp coral limestone, bamboo handrail stairs, wave-washed coastal rocks, tidal sandy paths.
data.waterAvailability: None on trail. Carry at least 1.0L of hydration.
data.safetyAdvisory: Wear protective footwear against sharp karst rocks. Check tide tables before entering the sea caves (accessible during low-to-mid tide).

waypoints.name: Bachawan North Cove Trailhead
waypoints.description: Trek departs from the northern end of Bachawan beach through coastal screwpine trees.

waypoints.name: Dampali Karst Overlook & Sea Arch
waypoints.description: Breathtaking bird-eye view of natural underwater limestone arches and coral gardens.

waypoints.name: Cliffside Bamboo Staircase
waypoints.description: Steep engineered wooden stairs descending down the limestone amphitheater.

waypoints.name: Swallow & Bat Sea Cave Entrance
waypoints.description: Hidden cave chamber where Pacific swiftlets nest. Crystal clear tidal pool at the base.

highlights: Hidden Karst Sea Caves & Natural Arch

data.name: Masadsad Terraces & Sunrise Ridge Eco-Trail
data.description: A serene pastoral trek traversing traditional stone-walled agricultural terraces, fruit orchards, giant bamboo groves, and panoramic sunrise ridge pavilions over eastern Sibale.
data.terrainType: Soft clay loam, terrace stone bunds, gentle rolling hills with shaded tree tunnels.
data.waterAvailability: Fresh coconut water and spring taps available in Masadsad village.
data.safetyAdvisory: Please stay on designated terrace paths to preserve local crops. Greet farmers warmly with "Maayong aga" (Good morning).

waypoints.name: Masadsad Barangay Eco-Hall
waypoints.description: Orientation board for local agricultural history and organic farm practices.

waypoints.name: Stone-Walled Upland Terraces
waypoints.description: Centuries-old stone irrigation terraces cultivating sweet taro and highland rice.

waypoints.name: Eastern Sunrise Ridge Pavilion
waypoints.description: Highest viewpoint on the loop with 180° views of the Philippine sea sunrise.

waypoints.name: Giant Bamboo Grove Canopy
waypoints.description: Shaded bamboo tunnel with natural wind song acoustics.

data.name: North Cape Lighthouse & Dos Hermanas Vista Trail
data.description: Rugged northern headland expedition following windswept savannah ridges to Sibale's automated navigation lighthouse with dramatic cliff vistas overlooking the Dos Hermanas twin islets.
data.terrainType: Grassy windswept ridge, exposed volcanic gravel, coastal cliff edge trails.
data.waterAvailability: No water sources along headland. Carry 2.0L water per hiker.
data.safetyAdvisory: High sea winds common along the cape. Keep away from edge margins during gusty conditions. Bring sun protection and hat ties.

waypoints.name: Tuburan Coastal Marker
waypoints.description: Coastal trailhead where habal-habal motorcycle road ends.

waypoints.name: Windswept Savannah Saddle
waypoints.description: Expansive grassy ridge where sea breeze meets mountain updrafts.

waypoints.name: North Cape Solar Lighthouse Beacon
waypoints.description: Solar-powered marine beacon guiding international vessels traversing Tablas Strait.

waypoints.name: Dos Hermanas Twin Islets Vista Point
waypoints.description: Northmost cliff outlook framing the legendary twin rocky islets rising from deep blue straits.

highlights: Dos Hermanas Twin Islets Birdseye View

data.name: Apiton Mangrove Boardwalk & Crystal Spring Eco-Walk
data.description: An educational nature walk traversing elevated bamboo and hardwood boardwalks through protected ancient mangrove forest to a pristine freshwater spring pool emerging from volcanic bedrock.
data.terrainType: Elevated wooden boardwalk, packed forest trail, natural limestone stepping stones.
data.waterAvailability: Potable freshwater spring pool at destination.
data.safetyAdvisory: Family and senior accessible walk. Watch your step on wooden planks during high tide moisture.

waypoints.name: Apiton Sanctuary Nature Center
waypoints.description: Eco-registration desk and mangrove seedling nursery.

waypoints.name: Ancient Rhizophora Mangrove Canopy Walk
waypoints.description: Shaded wooden pathway suspended above tidal channels teeming with mudskippers and fiddler crabs.

waypoints.name: Bukol Cold Spring Pool
waypoints.description: Clear freshwater bathing pool shaded by wild ferns and century-old banyan trees.
